verdict.rationale: Remote's first-party docs describe webhooks that push events to your application. Users register production callbacks after firing sandbox test deliveries, and a catalog of available event types is documented. Subscriptions, delivery history and replays can be managed via the CLI, and signature verification uses `X-Remote-Signature`. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that webhook registration and delivery work as documented.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: A webhook lets Remote push events to your application the moment something changes, so you do not have to poll the API.
Fire test deliveries against your endpoint in Sandbox before you register a production callback.
manage departments, custom fields, and webhook subscriptions, including delivery history and replays.
